about: In-app URLs the Go backend builds (emails, web push, share links, interview invites, SSO and Stripe returns), as of d11dee8. `source` is where each is built (file:line at d11dee8, for reading); the guard checks that the file still contains `goLiteral`, and that `url` resolves to a route in src/App.tsx. Placeholders stand in for tokens and ids. `spa: false` marks a URL nginx serves from the API rather than the app.
